name: Report to Ironforge
summary: Ironband’s report is bound for Ironforge from Thelsamar in Loch Modan. It carries news from the excavation site to Prospector Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers, where the stalled dig and missing blastpowder need attention.

sections.title: A Courier for the League
sections.body: The Explorers' League funds, supplies, and oversees archaeological expeditions across Khaz Modan. Prospector Ironband's dig in southern Loch Modan has run short of blasting supplies, and its overseers cannot simply requisition more nearby. At the Thelsamar inn, Jern Hornhelm entrusts you with Ironband's written report. You carry it over the mountain passes to Prospector Stormpike at the League's headquarters in Ironforge.

sections.title: The Stormpike Temper
sections.body: Prospector Stormpike brings fierce resolve to his work for the League. He is stationed in Ironforge's grand Library and Hall of Explorers, where he expects swift results from the League's digs. When Stormpike reads Ironband's report, he is outraged: Ironband does not account for a massive shipment of blastpowder sent weeks ago. The missing record points to a dangerous breakdown in Loch Modan's supply lines.

faq.q: Why does this report need to go all the way to Ironforge?
faq.answer: The Explorers' League controls the distribution of valuable supplies such as blastpowder. Field digs need formal approval from senior prospectors at the Hall of Explorers before they can order explosives.

Prospector Stormpike is a senior Explorers' League official based in Ironforge. He belongs to the proud Stormpike clan and is known for his short temper and impatience with stalled digs and missing supplies.

faq.q: Where did Ironband's original blastpowder go?
faq.answer: A shipment of blasting powder was sent weeks ago, but Ironband's report does not say he received it. Troggs or bandits may have ambushed the wagon on Loch Modan's roads.

faq.q: Where do you find Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge?
faq.answer: You can find Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge's Assembly of Explorers, also called the Library or Hall of Explorers, in the city's northeastern wing.

faq.q: Who gives you the report in Thelsamar?
faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm gives you the report at the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar. He coordinates reports and messages between Ironband's remote camp and the city leadership.

faq.q: What happens after Stormpike reads the report?
aliases: next quest after report to ironforge
faq.answer: After reading the report, Stormpike is furious about the missing munitions and stalled progress. He orders you to arrange a new shipment of blastpowder and take it straight back to Prospector Ironband.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Explorers' League's procedures and Clan Stormpike's legendary temper from life in your capital's halls.
As an Alliance member, you see how the Alliance links distant research camps in mountain valleys with Ironforge's military and scholarly leadership.
